old_description: Custom t-shirts, apparel, hats, stickers, drinkware, promotional items, and much more.
about:
Made In Hawaii is based in Pukalani, Hawaii. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public sources.

The shop specializes in custom screen printing, embroidery, stickers and labels, drinkware, hats and caps, totes and bags, and artwork design. It also produces promotional items such as lanyards, trucker hats, banners, signs, business cards, postcards, and notepads. An in-house art department assists customers with print-ready graphics. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Customers include non-profit organizations ordering shirts for fundraisers, community groups needing event apparel, retail businesses seeking branded merchandise, and corporate clients outfitting employees with custom drinkware. Testimonials reference orders ranging from a few custom shirts to several hundred pieces.

The company states its mission is to deliver top-quality products, friendly service, affordable pricing, and fast turnaround times with direct delivery. It emphasizes meeting tight deadlines as a core differentiator.
